verdict.rationale: PayPal documents and ships an official MCP server in both local (npx package) and remote hosted forms (mcp.paypal.com / mcp.sandbox.paypal.com) with documented auth, tool inventory (catalog, disputes, invoices, payments, subscriptions, insights), and support for MCP clients alongside other agent frameworks; a live probe confirms the remote MCP endpoint is real and OAuth-gated per spec. missing for 10: independent third-party hands-on validation of the MCP server working end-to-end with a real agent beyond PayPal's own docs/probe.
